results.title: Time to Jump-Start Congress
results.description: Another fortnight has come and gone—and not just any fortnight. Continuing a trend that began in 2015—and mirroring, in the political realm, the ratcheting up of global temperatures and resultant climatic catastrophes—this has been the 290th consecutive fortnight to have been worse than the one before. Appropriately, this one kicked off under cover of darkness. In the early morning hours of Saturday, August 8th, the full Senate voted, in effect, to combine the offices of Attorney General of the United States of America with that of Mr. Fixit of the Trump Organization. So, your mother was right: nothing good happens after midnight. Nine years earlier, ... Read more

results.description: NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS Notice is hereby given that the City of Hudson Oaks will hold Public Hearings on the following: A request for a specific use permit to allow for a "Day-Care Center, Child" being a 10,000 square foot facility on a portion of a 3.558 acres tract, Lot 2R1R1, Block 1, A.B. Cinema Development Addition, commonly known as 2050 Cinema Drive, Hudson Oaks, Parker County, Texas, and; A request for a specific use permit to allow for a "Package Liquor Store" a 5,000 square foot suite on a portion of a 2.793 acre tract, Lot 1, Block 1, Jerry Spencer Subdivision, commonly known as 3196 IH-20, Hudson Oaks, Parker County, Texas. The City of Hudson Oaks will conduct the Public Hearings on Tuesday, September 8, 2026 at 7:00 p.m., and Thursday, September 24, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. at the Hudson Oaks City Hall, 210 Hudson Oaks Drive, Hudson Oaks, Texas, 76087.All interested parties are invited to attend.
